title: AI in the Automotive Development Process: From Siloed Experiments to Industrialized Intelligence
publication: Study by Capgemini, TUM and ASIMI, with Elmar Frickenstein, Alois Knoll, Uwe Michael, Steffen Krause and Charlotte Link
summary: Every organization we asked already uses AI in engineering. Almost none scales it end to end. We put that question to senior leaders across OEMs, software Tier-1s, integrators, hyperscalers and research. Their answer: the wall is not the model, it is the organization. Only 20–30% of AI pilots reach production; those who design industrialization in from day one report more than 50%. Buy the model, own the context.
